import random, string

def generate_password(length=16, symbols=True):
    chars = string.ascii_letters + string.digits
    if symbols:
        chars += '!@#$%^&*'
    password = [
        random.choice(string.ascii_uppercase),
        random.choice(string.ascii_lowercase),
        random.choice(string.digits),
    ]
    password += [random.choice(chars) for _ in range(length - 3)]
    random.shuffle(password)
    return ''.join(password)

print(generate_password(16))   # e.g. Xk9#mP2$vL8nQr4!

import requests, re

def scrape(url):
    headers = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'}
    res     = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=5)
    # Extract page title
    title = re.search(r'<title>(.*?)</title>', res.text, re.I)
    # Extract all links
    links = re.findall(r'href=["\']([^"\'>]+)["\']', res.text)
    return {
        'title': title.group(1) if title else 'No title',
        'links': links[:10],
        'status': res.status_code
    }

data = scrape('https://example.com')
print(data['title'])
print(data['links'])

input: how much sleep do i need
output: Adults need 7-9 hours per night. Teens need 8-10 hours. Sleep deprivation harms memory, immunity, and mood. Quality matters as much as quantity.
Exercise improves cardiovascular health, strength, mood, and longevity. WHO recommends 150 min moderate aerobic exercise per week plus strength training twice weekly.
Stress is the body's response to demands or threats — releasing cortisol and adrenaline. Short-term stress can be helpful. Chronic stress harms heart, immunity, and mental health.
Mental health covers emotional, psychological, and social wellbeing. Conditions include anxiety, depression, ADHD. Treatment: therapy, medication, lifestyle changes.
The immune system defends against pathogens. White blood cells, antibodies, lymph nodes work together. Vaccines train it to recognize specific threats.
Diabetes is a condition where blood sugar is too high. Type 1: immune system destroys insulin-producing cells. Type 2: body becomes insulin resistant, often from lifestyle factors.
Caffeine is a natural stimulant in coffee, tea, and energy drinks. It blocks adenosine (sleep signal) receptors, increasing alertness. Half-life ~5-6 hours.
Antioxidants neutralize free radicals — unstable molecules that damage cells. Found in berries, dark chocolate, green tea, and colorful vegetables. May reduce cancer risk.
Inflation is the rate at which prices rise over time, reducing purchasing power. Central banks target ~2% annual inflation. Caused by demand increases, supply shortages, or money printing.
The stock market is where shares of public companies are bought and sold. Major indexes: S&P 500 (USA), NASDAQ (tech), Nikkei (Japan). Reflects economic confidence.
Cryptocurrency is digital currency using cryptography for security. Bitcoin (2009) was first. Others: Ethereum, Solana. Decentralized — no central bank controls it.
Bitcoin is the first and largest cryptocurrency, created in 2009 by the anonymous Satoshi Nakamoto. Limited to 21 million coins. Uses proof-of-work blockchain.
GDP (Gross Domestic Product) measures a country's economic output — total value of goods and services produced. USA has the world's largest GDP at ~$27 trillion.
A startup is a newly founded company aiming to scale rapidly with an innovative product. Funded by venture capital. Famous startups: Apple, Google, Facebook, Uber, Airbnb.
Marketing promotes products/services to attract customers. Includes digital marketing (SEO, social media, ads), content marketing, email campaigns, and branding.
Entrepreneurship is starting and running a business, taking financial risks for potential reward. Entrepreneurs identify problems and build solutions — often through startups.

input: what is artificial intelligence in business
output: AI in business automates repetitive tasks, analyzes data for insights, personalizes customer experiences, detects fraud, and powers chatbots. Transforming every industry.
Ecommerce is buying and selling goods online. Amazon is the world's largest. Models: B2C (Amazon), B2B (Alibaba), C2C (eBay). Global ecommerce is worth $6+ trillion.
The Sahara is the world's largest hot desert — 9.2 million km² across North Africa. Despite its reputation, 25% is sand dunes; the rest is rocky plateaus and mountains.
The Amazon River in South America carries more water than any other river — 20% of all fresh water flowing into the world's oceans. Over 3,000 species of fish live in it.
Mount Everest (8,849 m) is Earth's highest peak above sea level, in the Himalayas on the Nepal-Tibet border. First summited by Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay in 1953.
The Pacific is Earth's largest and deepest ocean — 165 million km², larger than all land combined. Contains the Mariana Trench (deepest point: 11,034 m).
India is in South Asia, bordered by Pakistan, China, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, and Myanmar. Population: 1.4 billion — the world's most populous country since 2023.
Europe is the second-smallest continent — 10.5 million km². Has 44 countries. The European Union (27 members) shares currency (Euro) and open borders.
Africa is the second-largest continent — 30.3 million km² with 54 countries. Most biodiverse continent. Home to the Sahara, Nile, Congo rainforest, and Serengeti.
Asia is the largest and most populous continent — 44.6 million km², 4.7 billion people. Home to the world's two largest economies (China, Japan) and tallest mountains.
Philosophy is the study of fundamental questions: existence, knowledge, ethics, mind, and language. Major branches: metaphysics, epistemology, ethics, logic, aesthetics.
Ethics is the branch of philosophy studying morality — what is right and wrong. Major theories: utilitarianism (greatest good), deontology (rules/duty), virtue ethics (character).
Logic is the study of valid reasoning and argument. A valid argument: if premises are true, conclusion must be true. Foundation of mathematics and computer science.
Consciousness is awareness of self and surroundings. One of science's biggest mysteries — we don't know how the brain produces subjective experience. Called 'the hard problem'.
Critical thinking is analyzing information objectively before forming conclusions. Skills: questioning assumptions, evaluating evidence, recognizing bias, logical reasoning.
Creativity is generating novel and useful ideas by connecting existing concepts in new ways. Can be developed — techniques: brainstorming, mind mapping, constraints, diverse input.
The blue whale is the largest animal ever known — up to 33 meters long and 200 tons. Its heart is the size of a small car. Found in all oceans.
The peregrine falcon is the fastest at 389 km/h in a dive. Fastest land animal: cheetah at 112 km/h. Fastest fish: sailfish at 110 km/h.
Mammals are warm-blooded vertebrates that nurse young with milk. ~5,500 species including humans, whales, bats, and elephants. Characterized by hair/fur and three middle ear bones.
Reptiles are cold-blooded vertebrates with scales. ~10,000 species: snakes, lizards, turtles, crocodilians. Most lay eggs. Descendants of the dinosaurs' lineage.
Insects are the most diverse animal group — over 1 million known species (possibly 10 million total). 6 legs, 3 body parts. Bees, ants, beetles, butterflies.
Coral reefs are marine ecosystems built by coral polyps — tiny animals with calcium carbonate skeletons. Cover 0.1% of ocean floor but support 25% of all marine species.
Dinosaurs were reptiles that dominated Earth for 165 million years. Went extinct ~66 million years ago when an asteroid hit Earth. Birds are living dinosaurs!
Biodiversity is the variety of life on Earth. About 8.7 million species estimated, with only 1.5 million catalogued. Threatened by habitat loss, climate change, and pollution.

Gravity is a fundamental force that attracts objects with mass toward each other. Earth's gravity pulls at 9.8 m/s². Described by Newton's law and Einstein's general relativity.
Gravity is the force pulling objects together. The stronger an object's mass, the stronger its gravity. Earth's gravity keeps us grounded and the Moon in orbit.
DNA (Deoxyribonucleic Acid) is the molecule carrying genetic instructions for all living things. It's a double helix made of 4 bases: A, T, C, G. Every cell in your body has 3 billion base pairs!
Machine learning is AI that learns from data without being explicitly programmed. Types: supervised (labeled data), unsupervised (finds patterns), reinforcement (learns by reward).
Machine learning trains models on data to make predictions. Example: show 1000 cat photos → model learns to recognize cats. Used in spam filters, recommendations, self-driving cars.
Deep learning uses neural networks with many layers to learn complex patterns. Powers image recognition, speech, and large language models like GPT and Claude.
A neural network is a system inspired by the human brain — layers of nodes (neurons) that process and transform data. More layers = deeper network = can learn more complex patterns.
